description: Narrative-dynamic / trope taxonomy used to tag each movie's DNA. 100 tags across character dynamics, plot structure, tone, theme, story scale, and presentation style, in one flat namespace so they can be compared as a single vector. Each tag carries plain-language synonyms so a free-text search (e.g. 'scary') can reach it without the user knowing the taxonomy's own vocabulary.

tags.label: Skill asymmetry
tags.description: Protagonist is dramatically more capable than the opposition.

tags.label: Underdog rise
tags.description: Protagonist starts weak and grows into power over the story.

tags.label: Mentor/loved-one death as catalyst
tags.description: A death early on triggers the protagonist's whole arc.

tags.label: Found family
tags.description: Unrelated characters form a chosen-family bond.

tags.label: Odd couple
tags.description: A mismatched pair is forced together; friction drives the story.

tags.label: Antihero lead
tags.description: Protagonist operates outside conventional morality.

tags.label: Rival becomes ally
tags.description: An antagonist turns into a collaborator.

tags.label: Mentor/student bond
tags.description: A teaching relationship structures the plot.

tags.label: Ensemble cast
tags.description: Story is distributed across a group rather than one lead.

tags.label: Lone wolf
tags.description: Protagonist is isolated by choice or circumstance.

tags.label: Revenge quest
tags.description: Plot is driven by the pursuit of vengeance.

tags.label: Heist / plan-execution
tags.description: Plan, execution, and complication structure around a theft or con.

tags.label: Ticking clock
tags.description: A hard deadline drives urgency.

tags.label: Nonlinear timeline
tags.description: Story is told out of chronological order.

tags.label: Twist reveal
tags.description: A major reversal recontextualizes everything before it.

tags.label: Slow burn
tags.description: Deliberately paced, escalating tension.

tags.label: Single location
tags.description: Action is confined largely to one setting.

tags.label: Chase structure
tags.description: An extended pursuit forms the narrative spine.

tags.label: Investigation-driven
tags.description: Plot unfolds through solving a mystery.

tags.label: Plan gone wrong
tags.description: A careful plan progressively falls apart.

tags.label: Bleak
tags.description: Grim, downbeat atmosphere throughout.

tags.label: Dark comedy
tags.description: Comedy drawn from morbid or taboo material.

tags.label: Stylized violence
tags.description: Action choreographed as visual spectacle.

tags.label: Quiet minimalism
tags.description: Sparse dialogue, restrained style.

tags.label: Dreamlike / surreal
tags.description: Reality-bending or hallucinatory tone.

tags.label: High camp
tags.description: Deliberately exaggerated, theatrical tone.

tags.label: Tender sincerity
tags.description: Emotionally earnest, unironic tone.

tags.label: Tense dread
tags.description: Sustained anxiety or suspense.

tags.label: Whimsical charm
tags.description: Light, playful tone.

tags.label: Gritty realism
tags.description: Unglamorized, naturalistic tone.

tags.label: Identity reinvention
tags.description: A character reshapes who they are.

tags.label: Systemic corruption
tags.description: Institutions or power structures are the real antagonist.

tags.label: Technology disruption
tags.description: New technology reshapes the characters' world.

tags.label: Moral ambiguity
tags.description: No clearly right side.

tags.label: Coming of age
tags.description: Passage from youth toward adulthood.

tags.label: Grief processing
tags.description: Story centers on mourning and loss.

tags.label: Class conflict
tags.description: Tension rooted in economic or social stratification.

tags.label: Found purpose
tags.description: Protagonist discovers meaning or a calling.

tags.label: Survival against odds
tags.description: Endurance against an overwhelming threat.

tags.label: Love across a divide
tags.description: Romance complicated by opposing worlds or factions.

tags.label: Epic scale
tags.description: Sweeping scope: spans years, countries, or a huge cast; big canvas storytelling.

tags.label: Intimate scale
tags.description: Small canvas: a handful of characters carry the whole film.

tags.label: Meta / fourth wall
tags.description: Characters acknowledge the audience or the fact they're in a movie.

tags.label: Found footage
tags.description: Presented as recovered, in-world recorded footage.

tags.label: Time loop
tags.description: Character relives the same period repeatedly until something changes.

tags.label: Unreliable narrator
tags.description: The narrator's account can't be fully trusted, reshaping how the story reads.

tags.label: Body swap
tags.description: Identities, minds, or bodies get swapped or transferred.

tags.label: Courtroom drama
tags.description: Trial proceedings and legal argument drive the plot.

tags.label: Road journey
tags.description: Physical travel across distance structures the plot.

tags.label: Real time
tags.description: Told in continuous, unbroken time.

tags.label: War / conflict
tags.description: Armed conflict or military life drives the story.

tags.label: Fish out of water
tags.description: A character is dropped into an unfamiliar world or culture.

tags.label: Sacrifice for others
tags.description: A character gives up something enormous, often their life, for someone else.

tags.label: Nostalgia / period
tags.description: Wistful, lovingly recreated sense of a bygone era.

tags.label: Reluctant hero
tags.description: Protagonist doesn't want the responsibility thrust upon them.

tags.label: Chosen one
tags.description: Prophecy or destiny singles out the protagonist.

tags.label: Villain POV
tags.description: Story is told substantially from the antagonist's own perspective.

tags.label: Rivalry driven
tags.description: An intense, ongoing rivalry between two characters drives the story.

tags.label: Multi-generational cast
tags.description: Story follows multiple generations of a family.

tags.label: Animal companion
tags.description: A non-human animal plays a major, bonded role.

tags.label: AI companion
tags.description: An AI or robot serves as a major companion or character.

tags.label: Criminal mastermind
tags.description: A brilliant schemer plans and orchestrates events from the shadows.

tags.label: Dual timeline
tags.description: Two distinct time periods are interwoven, usually converging.

tags.label: Multiple POV
tags.description: Story alternates between several characters' viewpoints.

tags.label: Anthology structure
tags.description: Several short, loosely connected stories make up one film.

tags.label: Reverse chronology
tags.description: Told backwards, from the end toward the beginning.

tags.label: Epistolary
tags.description: Told through letters, diaries, or recordings.

tags.label: Competition / tournament
tags.description: Structured around a contest, tournament, or game.

tags.label: Escape plot
tags.description: Protagonists work to escape captivity or a place.

tags.label: Rescue mission
tags.description: Plot is driven by rescuing someone.

tags.label: Prophecy fulfillment
tags.description: A foretold event drives and shapes the plot.

tags.label: Descent into madness
tags.description: Structure follows a character's psychological unraveling.

tags.label: Mockumentary
tags.description: Presented as a fake documentary, usually comedic.

tags.label: Espionage / double cross
tags.description: Spies, secret agents, and shifting loyalties drive the plot.

tags.label: Disaster survival
tags.description: A catastrophic event, natural or man-made, triggers the plot.

tags.label: Slasher structure
tags.description: A killer stalks and picks off characters one by one.

tags.label: Romantic tone
tags.description: Swoony, romance-forward mood throughout.

tags.label: Melancholic
tags.description: Wistful, reflective sadness — softer and quieter than bleak.

tags.label: Absurdist
tags.description: Reality operates on illogical, nonsensical rules.

tags.label: Claustrophobic
tags.description: Oppressive, confined atmosphere.

tags.label: Gothic
tags.description: Atmospheric, macabre, romantic-horror aesthetic.

tags.label: Noir
tags.description: Cynical, shadowy, hardboiled crime aesthetic.

tags.label: Wholesome / family
tags.description: Warm, earnest, explicitly family-friendly tone.

tags.label: Raunchy / irreverent
tags.description: Crude, taboo-breaking humor.

tags.label: Man vs. nature
tags.description: Humanity or an individual struggles against natural forces.

tags.label: Environmentalism
tags.description: Ecological themes and humanity's relationship with the environment.

tags.label: Addiction / recovery
tags.description: Substance abuse and the path to recovery.

tags.label: Mental illness
tags.description: Psychological or mental health struggles are central to the story.

tags.label: Faith and doubt
tags.description: Religious or spiritual questioning.

tags.label: Immigrant experience
tags.description: Displacement, assimilation, and cultural identity across borders.

tags.label: Gender identity
tags.description: Themes of gender roles or identity.

tags.label: Legacy and inheritance
tags.description: What one generation leaves behind for the next.

tags.label: Redemption arc
tags.description: A character seeks to atone for past wrongs.

tags.label: Betrayal
tags.description: Broken trust drives the emotional core.

tags.label: Obsession
tags.description: A consuming fixation drives a character.

tags.label: Forbidden knowledge
tags.description: Seeking or uncovering dangerous truths.

tags.label: Isolation / disconnection
tags.description: Thematic loneliness or disconnection from society.

tags.label: Coming home
tags.description: A return to one's origins or homecoming.

tags.label: Justice vs. law
tags.description: Questioning whether legal justice is true justice.

tags.label: Duty vs. desire
tags.description: A character torn between obligation and personal want.
